tools.name: cbo_list_clients
tools.description: List the company's clients (customers). GET /clients.

tools.name: cbo_get_client
tools.description: Get one client by id. GET /clients/{id}.

tools.name: cbo_create_client
tools.description: Create a client in the company. client_type 1 = person, 2 = company. Creates a record: not idempotent. POST /clients.

tools.name: cbo_update_client
tools.description: Change the given fields of one client; other fields stay as they are. PATCH /clients/{id}.

tools.name: cbo_list_suppliers
tools.description: List the company's suppliers (vendors). GET /suppliers.

tools.name: cbo_get_supplier
tools.description: Get one supplier by id. GET /suppliers/{id}.

tools.name: cbo_list_invoices
tools.description: List the company's sales invoices, with optional status, date and client filters. GET /invoices.

tools.name: cbo_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one sales invoice by id, with its lines and totals. GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: cbo_list_supplier_invoices
tools.description: List purchase (supplier) invoices, with optional status, date and supplier filters. GET /supplier-invoices.

tools.name: cbo_get_supplier_invoice
tools.description: Get one supplier invoice by id. GET /supplier-invoices/{id}.

tools.name: cbo_list_orders
tools.description: List sales orders and offers, with optional client and date filters. GET /orders.

tools.name: cbo_get_order
tools.description: Get one sales order or offer by id, with its items. GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: cbo_list_client_receipts
tools.description: List money collected from clients (cash receipts and returns). GET /client-receipts.

tools.name: cbo_list_supplier_payments
tools.description: List money paid to suppliers (cash payments and returns). GET /supplier-payments.

tools.name: cbo_list_products
tools.description: List parent products (master groups) with their variant counts and price range. GET /products.

tools.name: cbo_get_product
tools.description: Get one parent product by id, including its variants (children). GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: cbo_list_product_children
tools.description: List product variants (children) with SKU, barcode and visibility. GET /product-children.

tools.name: cbo_create_product
tools.description: Create a parent product (master group) in the company. Creates a record: not idempotent. POST /products.

tools.name: cbo_update_product
tools.description: Change the given fields of one parent product; other fields stay as they are. PATCH /products/{id}.

tools.name: cbo_list_product_groups
tools.description: List product groups (categories), optionally under one parent group. GET /groups.

tools.name: cbo_list_bank_accounts
tools.description: List the company's own bank accounts (IBAN, SWIFT). GET /bank-details.

tools.name: cbo_list_payment_links
tools.description: List payment links the company created for customers. GET /payment-links.

tools.name: cbo_get_payment_link
tools.description: Get one payment link by id. GET /payment-links/{id}.

tools.name: cbo_list_invoice_series
tools.description: List invoice numbering series. GET /invoice-series.

tools.name: cbo_list_invoice_types
tools.description: List the company's invoice (document) types. GET /invoice-types.

tools.name: cbo_list_taxes
tools.description: List tax rates (VAT and others) available to the company. GET /taxes.

tools.name: cbo_list_expense_categories
tools.description: List expense categories. GET /expense-categories.

tools.name: cbo_list_measurement_units
tools.description: List measurement units (pieces, kg, hours, …). GET /measurement-units.

tools.name: cbo_list_countries
tools.description: List countries with their codes. GET /countries.

tools.name: cbo_list_tax_offices
tools.description: List Greek tax offices (ΔΟΥ) with their codes. GET /tax-offices.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "cbo_list_countries" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "cbo_list_tax_offices" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
